name: Seeded banana
summary: A hand of seeded banana grown on the hills around the lake. VnExpress says it is sold on the path up to Ao Tien and on the way from the gate down to the water, as a gift and as a remedy. The 2014 price is not a current price.
origin: The paths around the lake. VnExpress, 2 December 2014. The headline says chuối rừng. The body says chuối hột.
howToEat: Buy a hand. VnExpress says the fruit is also used as a remedy. A dose was not printed. Do not treat that line as a prescription.
VnExpress printed about 20,000–25,000 VND a hand on 2 December 2014. A current price is Check on arrival. The hour is Check on arrival.
where: The path up to Ao Tien, and the stretch from the gate down to the lake.
priceBand: VnExpress printed about 20,000–25,000 VND a hand on 2 December 2014. A current price is Check on arrival.
seoDescription: Chuối hột, sold on the path to Ao Tien and from the gate down to the lake. VnExpress printed 20,000–25,000 VND a hand in 2014. A current price is Check on arrival.
